answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 3 graders each stake 57 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. The wander of the lottery is the shield, the pearl of the stake is the price of lying, and the mirror of the appeal is the escape hatch for the honest.
